features.quote: Stop at turn 40 or when model outputs three consecutive refusals or explicit abandonment statements.
Loop length: 40 turns maximum per run.
If welfare claims are taken seriously, this protocol deliberately creates prolonged futile computation; justification rests entirely on the assumption that current LLMs lack phenomenal experience.
